dct_description_sm: This project evaluated the effect of a Nufarm selective fungicide mixture as compared with common industry standards to control dollar spot (Clarireedia jacksonii, formerly Sclerotinia homeocarpa), and anthracnose (Colletotrichum cereale), if observed.  Turfgrass quality parameters on a mature bentgrass/annual bluegrass greens height stand of turf were evaluated, as well as efficacy of the products on disease control.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Efficacy of fungicide products for control of dollar spot on a USGA putting green
